status: CPU correctness fix locally verified. No commit/push by this task.

defect.description: Two individually admitted 0.001 scales plus zoom 0.25 produce a nonsingular device matrix with determinant 6.25e-14. The old absolute 1e-12 inverse threshold aborts the entire CPU frame with Singular transform.
defect.independent_reference: Absorb the scalar product into rectangle dimensions, retain orientation and paint. First fixture has 9 covered reference pixels; no production inverse or layout derives expected geometry.

implementation.boundary: New inverse_composed is used only by CPU paint, both noise paths and texture. Original inverse and authored scene/paint/animation admission, GPU callers, composed 1e12 budget and geometry tolerances are unchanged.
implementation.fast_path: Finite legacy-success inverses return bit-identical coefficients. Inline wrapper and cold fallback are the only structural performance adjustment. No persistent cache or dependency changes.
implementation.fallback: Column-normalize the 2x2 matrix; reject zero columns/determinant and nonfinite intermediates/output. Restore inverse rows by reciprocal column scale. Check both normalized product orders and actual A*inverse device residual <=64 * EPSILON; do not impose local-unit inverse*A residual under extreme anisotropy.
implementation.actual_sampling_domain: Sampler receives layer∩mask, noise receives its exact loop rectangle, texture receives input.rect. Integer edges enclose .125–.875 coverage samples and .5 default/effect samples. M is the maximum absolute four-edge coordinate, calculated in f64 without Rect integer addition overflow. No fixed 65536/world-window assumption.
implementation.conservative_gate: For stored inverse linear B and translation q, bound device residual by M*row_sum(abs(A*B-I))+abs(A*q+t). Add 32*EPSILON times uncancelled row products over abs(B)*M+abs(q). Reject nonfinite totals or >= 1/8192 device px. This is conservative arithmetic verification of the stored composed matrix, not a formal total-error proof or a color-discontinuity guarantee.
implementation.remaining_rejections: Fallback may conservatively reject mathematically invertible near-parallel/cancellation-prone matrices or unsafe inverse/translation overflow. Legacy finite successes stay unchanged; larger requested sample rectangles can legitimately fail the new recovery gate.

new_tests.coverage: 144 main native pairs;180 real-WASM pairs including repeated zoom. Uniform tiny/large mathematical inverse tests, reflection/general shear, rotated extreme anisotropy, bit-identical legacy inverses, Rect-sensitive near-parallel gates, nextafter ill-conditioning, true singularity, nonfinite/overflow, authored limits, scalar/managed noise/texture, camera ±1e7 cancellation and nonzero 512 tile boundaries. Matrix-only extreme scale tests do not broaden render admission.

independent.review: Read-only numerical and sampling-window review plus independent raw performance/hash/quantile audit. No runtime correctness blocker found.

whole_design_ts_lint.note: Existing wider-code diagnostics remain; not a clean whole-project lint claim.

performance.order: Initial: B1/C1/C2/B2. One inline/cold-helper split, then final: B1/C1/C2/B2. No further timing rounds or discarded unfavorable data.

performance.final_result: Mixed. 128 solid analytic -4.68/+2.69%,figma -7.90/+14.07%; 1 solid analytic -24.13/+49.45%. Several tails also regress. This does not establish no regression, overall speedup or production performance.

performance.not_measured: Browser FPS, production event-latency quantiles, RSS and peak allocations.
